chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan (may God be pleased with him) narrated that Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated that Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah al-Barqi, from Abi al-Zajra', from Suleiman, from Abi Nadrah, from Abi Sa'id al-Khudri, that the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said:

Whoever undergoes phlebotomy on the Tuesday of the seventeenth, nineteenth, or twenty-first day of the month, it will be a cure for him from every ailment of the year. And for what is other than that, it is a cure for headache, toothache, insanity, leprosy, and vitiligo.
ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual and physical benefits of undergoing phlebotomy on Tuesdays according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Al-Khisal*, this hadith highlights the Prophetic tradition of *al-hijama* (cupping) as a divinely sanctioned medical practice, emphasizing the spiritual and physical efficacy of timing the procedure on Tuesdays. It distinguishes between the general therapeutic benefits of performing cupping on the 17th, 19th, or 21st of the lunar month, and the specific curative power for ailments like madness and leprosy when done on other days, reflecting the Shia emphasis on integrating spiritual devotion with practical health measures.
